validity.researcher_notes: The line is real. Reports of the 2023 explosion say it happened on a section taken out of service for repair, with parallel lines still carrying gas. The operator is blank on the sheet because several Gazprom subsidiaries run sections of the line.

fills.researcher_notes: The line is run in sections by several Gazprom subsidiaries. News reports name Gazprom Transgaz Yugorsk for one section only. No page names one operator for the whole line, so the sheet is left blank and the question stays open.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Reports of May 2023 say the 2023 fire was on a section out of service for repair. Other lines kept gas flowing. The line is treated as operating.
